Implement a pure state transition module and export exactly `{ initialLoadState, reduceItemLoad }` using CommonJS. `initialLoadState` is a frozen object equal to `{ selected: null, isLoading: false, isSuccess: false, isError: false, message: '' }`. `reduceItemLoad(state, event)` accepts a state with exactly those fields and an event whose `type` is `START`, `SUCCEED`, `FAIL`, or `RESET`. `START` requires no other fields and clears prior data, status, and message while setting loading. `SUCCEED` requires a plain-object `item`, stores a shallow copy, and marks success. `FAIL` requires a string `message`, clears the selected item, and marks error. `RESET` requires no other fields and returns a fresh object with the initial values. Reject unknown or extra event fields and malformed state with `TypeError`. Every call returns a new state object, never mutates either argument, and never retains the supplied `event.item` object.
